title: Controller & Machine Strategy Validation
brief: Pre-validate strategy compatibility with controller and machine. Fallback chains. Cost-optimal and safety-first decision engines.

units.title: ControllerStrategyValidatorEngine
units.description: Validate strategy executable on target controller: NURBS, look-ahead, HSM modes, axes, work offsets.

units.title: MachineStrategyConstraintEngine
units.description: Validate against machine: RPM, power, acceleration, jerk, rapid traverse, magazine capacity.
units.note: 694-line engine on disk + passing tests (pre-existing at gap check time 2026-04-16)

units.title: Strategy fallback chain
units.description: Auto-fallback when incompatible: NURBS spiral → linear spiral → zigzag. Logged with explanation.

units.title: Wire into PostProcessorPipelineEngine
units.description: Phase 0.5 pre-check: validate strategy compatibility before post-processing.
units.note: Stage 0.55 already present; extended at 84c74900 to invoke StrategyFallbackChainEngine on controller incompatibility and surface fallback_chosen + explanation in pipeline findings

units.title: Cost-optimal decision engine
units.description: At every decision: cycle_time_cost + tool_cost + energy_cost + scrap_risk. Select minimum total cost.

units.title: Safety decision engine
units.description: At every decision: collision/overload/chatter/thermal risk. Safety overrides cost.

units.title: Dispatcher wiring
units.note: camDispatcher: 11 actions wired — strategy_controller_validate, strategy_machine_validate, strategy_find_compatible_controllers, strategy_find_best_machine, strategy_compatibility_matrix, strategy_cost_compute/decide/sensitivity, strategy_safety_assess/decide/filter, plus U03 strategy_fallback_chain + strategy_fallback_default_chain added at 84c74900

units.title: Tests
units.note: 110 tests pass across 5 CAMX-MS2 engines (Controller, Machine, CostOptimal, SafetyDecision, FallbackChain)
